decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet still has its own page in 2024, so the firm keeps presenting it, but it took little investment and carries little public commitment, and the sister design C has already been dropped.
This hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium craftsmanship piece that fits the firm's identity and was presented on its own page in both years, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment.
The firm promoted the Ison corner bench publicly in 2024 as a new interpretation of a classic, so it is visibly committed to it despite the reduced page presence.
This carpet is still presented on its own page, but as a low-investment variant close to the core range it is easy to cut if a collection is pruned.
The swivel shell chair is a multi-model line with significant development and tooling investment and continued own-page presence, which makes the firm strongly committed to it.
